feeds.title: We're Not Wizards
feeds.description: We're Not Wizards is a board game review podcast hosted by Frank and Chris. The blog features reviews of new and upcoming board games, as well as articles on board game design, strategy, and culture.

feeds.title: The Opinionated Gamers » Kickstarter
feeds.description: Here at the Opinionated Gamers, we're passionate about games. We love to play them, we love to think about them and we love to write about them. On our blog, the Opinionated Gamers, we have a section for Kickstarter games, where we share our opinions, impressions, and evaluations of games that are seeking funding on the platform.

feeds.title: Indiegogo
feeds.description: Millions of people around the world visit Indiegogo to find clever and unconventional things that solve everyday problems large and small. By giving entrepreneurs everywhere a platform to launch new and groundbreaking products, we help surface innovations in tech, design, and much more, all before they go mainstream. Indiegogo is the leading crowdfunding platform for tech products, as well as the only full-lifecycle platform for art projects, social impact campaigns, and environmental innovation projects.

feeds.title: CoolBacker
feeds.description: CoolBacker is a website that collects the coolest crowdfunding projects from around the web. It features products from various categories such as gadgets, home, outdoor, fitness, and accessories

feeds.title: Board Game Quest
feeds.description: Follow the Board Game Quest for Board Game News, Reviews, and More! With new articles posted every day, they have everything you need to find that next great tabletop game! A site dedicated to board game reviews, news and more. Everything you need to find the next great game to play on your tabletop.

feeds.title: Rock Manor Games » Kickstarter
feeds.description: Rock Manor Games is a small independent game publisher founded and run by myself (Mike Gnade) as a creative outlet for all my game projects, prototypes, and ideas. It wouldn't be possible without the support of a bunch of talented independent contractors, artists, game designers, volunteers, and fans. Based in Wilmington, DE and distributed worldwide, Rock Manor Games' brands include Maximum Apocalypse, Set a Watch, and Brass Empire. Their blog shares a category of Kickstarter that features information of games seeking funding.

feeds.title: RPGnews.com
feeds.description: ENWorld.org is a website and forum dedicated to tabletop role-playing games (TTRPGs), particularly Dungeons & Dragons (D&D). It was founded in 1997 by Sean K. Reynolds and has since become one of the most popular TTRPG websites in the world.

feeds.title: ComixLaunch Blog
feeds.description: The ComixLaunch blog is about crowdfunding for comic creators. It covers topics such as how to title your Kickstarter project, the Kickstarter success rate for comic projects, and the pros and cons of using Indiegogo crowdfunding platform. The website is run by Tyler James, a comic creator and publisher who has raised over $400,000 on Kickstarter for his projects.

feeds.title: Mid-Life Game Geek » Kickstarter
feeds.description: Midlife Gamer Geek is a blog that covers pop culture news, reviews, and interviews. Their Kickstarter category features articles on tabletop games, video games, and other projects that are currently seeking funding on the crowdfunding platform.

feeds.title: Atomic Junk Shop » Kickstarter Is Your Friend!
feeds.description: Atomic Junk Shop is a blog site that reviews crowdfunding projects from platforms like Kickstarter and Humble Bundle. It showcases projects from various categories such as comics, books, games, and art. It also offers tips and guides for crowdfunding creators and backers, as well as interviews and news from the crowdfunding scene.

feeds.title: Engadget » Kickstater
feeds.description: Engadget is a web magazine with obsessive daily coverage of everything new in gadgets and consumer electronics. Follow the magazine to get the latest Kickstarter info from our tech-obsessed editors with breaking news, in-depth reviews, hands-on videos, and our insights on future products.

feeds.title: ProductHype
feeds.description: ProductHype is a website that showcases the best new products on Earth in an absurdly unique way. They focus on products that are truly innovative and unique, rather than just the latest gadgets and gizmos.

feeds.title: Kick Agency News
feeds.description: KA is a news site reporting about upcoming Kickstarter and Gamefound board game projects and late pledges. Our experience comes from decades spent counting meeples and placing tiles. We get a kick out of games.

feeds.title: Tabletop Crowdfunding Blog
feeds.description: The Tabletop Crowdfunding Platform is dedicated to tabletop games! An all-in-one solution that combines crowdfunding campaigns, real-time pledge manager, and much more. It also offers tips and guides for crowdfunding creators, as well as interviews and news from the crowdfunding networks

feeds.title: Gaming Cypher » Kickstarter
feeds.description: Gaming Cypher is your #1 source for Xbox, PlayStation, Nintendo, and mobile games' latest news, Indie development, reviews, updates, and more. Gaming Cypher's blog delivers the most authoritative reviews, up-to-date news, and announcements for the latest Kickstarter games, video game consoles, and tools.

feeds.title: Tabletop Gaming News » Kickstarter
feeds.description: Tabletop Gaming News is a website devoted to publishing news, review, and articles for Tabletop, Boardgames, Miniatures, RPGs and Card Games! Here you will find latest news about tabletop projects on Kickstarter.

feeds.title: Asylum Press Blog
feeds.description: Asylum Press is a comic book and graphic novel publisher founded in 1999 by Frank Forte. The Company publishes books within the horror, fantasy, and action-adventure genres. Head to their blog for the latest news and helpful blog articles about comic book writing, comic book art, and comic book publishing.

feeds.title: Two Gargoyles Blog » Comics Kickstarter
feeds.description: The Two Gargoyles Comics website has a blog category for Kickstarter where they post articles about their own Kickstarter campaigns and other Kickstarter projects that are related to gaming, comics, and other related stuff.

feeds.title: EmperorFBA.com Blog » Kickstarter
feeds.description: Since 2010, EmperorFBA.com has been consulting businesses large and small on supply chain, merchandising, product development, sourcing, & strategy. We are entrepreneurs and builders ourselves with thousands of project of experience. Read our blog to learn more about the Kickstarter platform, its proper uses, crowdfunding information, industry news, and more.

feeds.title: CrowdCrux Blog
feeds.description: A blog by Salvador Briggman that helps individuals run successful crowdfunding campaigns. CrowdCrux is a crowdfunding news website and resource. We provide articles news updates that help entrepreneurs, investors, business owners, and creative types take advantage of the emerging crowdfunding industry.

feeds.title: Godhood Comics Blog
feeds.description: Godhood Comics is a black-owned and independent comic book publisher based in Atlanta, Georgia. We create, produce, and publish high-quality diverse IPs featuring 100% BIPOC leads.
